mod: MANUAL TRANSMISSION V10 (CET mod, game copy)
problem: GameOptions.Toggle("Vehicle","BlockChangeGear","true"/"false") FLIPS the option and ignores the value argument. Every SetLock/enter/exit call therefore alternated the engine gear lock instead of setting it, so the game's automatic gearbox fought MT's forced gear (SyncEngineState re-forces the gear each frame). Symptoms: inconsistent upshifts, wheel/display gear mismatch, 'toggle' not yielding automatic, RB15 capped ~300 km/h (held in 5th/6th; 7th is 105 m/s = 378 km/h). Most visible on the RB15 because its gear spread is widest.

fix.modules/gearbox.lua: BaseGearbox.ReadBlockChangeGear()/SetBlockChangeGear(flag): GameOptions.SetBool, verified by GameOptions.Get, fallback GameOptions.Set(string), last-resort single Toggle; SetLock always writes the engine option (no stale-flag shortcut).
fix.modules/stateManager.lua: SetupVehicleState / ResetVehicleState use BaseGearbox.SetLock(false|true) instead of raw Toggle.
fix.init.lua: onShutdown uses SetLock(false); onUpdate: when settings.enabled == false the lock is released and throttle/clutch handed back (real automatic); when enabled, a 1 s watchdog re-asserts BlockChangeGear == isManualMode and logs '[MT/diag] BlockChangeGear drift detected' if anything else flipped it.

verify: drive RB15 in manual: [MT/diag] lines should show BlockChangeGear == locked at all times; 'Enable Mod' off -> car shifts itself; 7th gear reaches >300 km/h
